# Voice Pipes

> A Mac menu bar app (Apple silicon, macOS 14+): hold a hotkey, talk, and your words appear where you're typing,
> transcribed on the Mac. It also reads text aloud and runs voice pipelines. `vp` is its agent-first command line.

## For agents

- [Install and set up Voice Pipes for your user](https://voicepipes.app/install.md): a step-by-step guide for an AI
  agent to install the app, walk the user through permissions, say hello out loud and run a one-minute demo.

## Docs

- [Install from a terminal](https://voicepipes.app/docs/install)
- [The vp command](https://voicepipes.app/docs/cli)
- [config.toml: tracks and settings](https://voicepipes.app/docs/config)
- [vp for agents](https://voicepipes.app/docs/agents)
- [Key setup (OpenRouter, TypeSafe Jev)](https://voicepipes.app/setup)
